# Generic interface default access

An independently compiled Kotlin interface binds a nominally bounded method
formal through an invariant binary converter input and unary result. Genuine
compatibility accessors call the same interface default body on the original
receiver. Frozen Java callers, reflection and method handles check default and
virtual dispatch, partial construction, wide values, nulls and failure order.
Original class/method Signatures and all compiler metadata are audited; one
reported private helper retains the same complete method Signature.
